verdict.rationale: Direct probes show Discord serves an llms.txt index at docs.discord.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its developer docs are also available as markdown pages that tell agents to fetch that index, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is additionally published on GitHub, though as a preview. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.discord.com/llms.txt # Documentation - Discord
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.discord.com/llms.txt
The official discord/discord-api-spec repository publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document
